name: ProteinMPNN + RLFE + GeoGate
tagline: Augments ProteinMPNN edges with relative local-frame rotations and gates messages by frame-conditioned sigmoids.
formula: $$ R^{\text{rel}}_{ij} = F_i^{\top} F_j \in \mathbb{R}^{3\times3}, \quad g_{ij} = \sigma\!\big(\mathrm{MLP}(\mathrm{vec}(R^{\text{rel}}_{ij}))\big), \quad m_{ij} = g_{ij} \odot \mathrm{MPNN}(h_i, h_j, e_{ij}) $$

key_hyperparams.name: num_rbf
key_hyperparams.role: RBF distance bins per atom pair

key_hyperparams.name: rel_frame_dim
key_hyperparams.role: flattened relative rotation features per edge

init_recovers: ProteinMPNN baseline when the geo-gate saturates to 1
diff_from_baseline: Extends the ProteinMPNN baseline (25 all-atom RBFs + positional edges) with a per-edge 9-d relative local-frame rotation $F_i^\top F_j$, which is concatenated into edge features and also fed through a sigmoid MLP that element-wise gates each MPNN message.

name: GeoContext + Two-Scale Aggregation
tagline: Edge-gated MPNN that fuses geometric-KNN and sequence-decay aggregates, then interpolates with a global protein context vector.
formula:
$$ m_{ij} = g_{ij}^{\text{edge}} \odot \phi(h_i, h_j, e_{ij}), \quad a_{\text{geo}} = \tfrac{\sum_j m_{ij} M_{ij}}{\sum_j M_{ij}}, \quad a_{\text{seq}} = \tfrac{\sum_j e^{-0.35\,k} m_{ij}}{\sum_j e^{-0.35\,k}} $$
$$ \tilde a = \alpha\,a_{\text{geo}} + (1-\alpha)\,a_{\text{seq}}, \quad h_i \leftarrow \mathrm{LN}\!\big(h_i + \beta_i \tilde a + (1-\beta_i) c\big),\;\; c = \tfrac{\sum_i h_i M_i}{\sum_i M_i} $$

key_hyperparams.name: seq_decay
key_hyperparams.role: exp decay rate over neighbor index k for sequence-near aggregation

diff_from_baseline: Replaces ProteinMPNN's plain mean-aggregation with edge-gated messages aggregated under two reweightings (geometric KNN mean and exponential-decay sequence proximity), fused by a learned mix gate, and finally interpolated against a length-pooled global protein context per layer.

name: Multi-head Geo-Attention + Edge Update
tagline: KNN encoder with multi-head attention message passing, dynamic edge updates, and a learnable virtual Cb anchor.
formula:
$$ V_{ij} = W_V[h_i;h_j;e_{ij}], \quad b_{ij}^h = \tfrac{W_B^h[h_i;h_j;e_{ij}]}{\sqrt{d_h}}, \quad \alpha_{ij}^h = \mathrm{softmax}_j(b_{ij}^h) $$
$$ h_i \leftarrow \mathrm{LN}\!\big(h_i + W_O \sum_{j,h} \alpha_{ij}^h V_{ij}^h\big), \quad e_{ij} \leftarrow e_{ij} + W_E[h_i;h_j;e_{ij}] $$

key_hyperparams.name: virtual_cb
key_hyperparams.role: learnable Cb anchor in local frame

key_hyperparams.name: edge_in_dim
key_hyperparams.role: edge feature width: RBF + direction + 4 frame angles

diff_from_baseline: Replaces the scaffold's sum-mean MPNN with a multi-head attention layer whose attention bias is learned from concatenated [h_i;h_j;e_{ij}] features, and adds a per-layer edge update plus a learnable virtual-Cb position used in the node features.

name: Geometric Transformer + Edge Bias
tagline: PiFold-style 15 atom-pair RBFs and frame-rotation edges fed into a wide multi-head transformer with edge-feature attention bias.
formula:
$$ \mathrm{Attn}_{ij}^h = \frac{(W_q h_i)\cdot(W_k[h_j;e_{ij}])}{\sqrt{d_h}} + W_b^h e_{ij} $$
$$ h_i \leftarrow \mathrm{LN}(h_i + W_o\,\mathrm{Aggr}_j \alpha_{ij} W_v[h_j;e_{ij}]), \quad e_{ij} \leftarrow \mathrm{LN}(e_{ij} + \mathrm{MLP}([h_i;h_j;e_{ij}])) $$
diff_from_baseline: Combines PiFold-like rich atom-pair geometry (3 virtual atoms, 15 inter-residue RBF channels, relative-frame rotation features) with a wider transformer encoder (192-d, 8 layers, 4 heads) where edge features inject a per-head additive attention bias and edges are updated each layer.
